title: Payments Counted Against the Debit-Card Ceiling (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Payments risk memorandum clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts**: which of the account's recent payments are counted against the debit-card ceiling of the day.

## Clause

The payments counted against the debit-card ceiling are:
- **every card and bank-debit payment** (debit card, credit card and ACH bank debit) received in the last month, where one or more credit-card payments were received in the last month and one or more bank-debit payments were received in the last three months;
- **the debit-card and credit-card payments** received in the last month, where one or more credit-card payments were received in the last month and no bank-debit payment was received in the last three months;
- **the debit-card payments** received in the last month, in every other case.

The total of the payments counted is subtracted from the amount the debit-card ceiling starts from.

## How the windows and amounts are read

- A payment is received in the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10, the last month starts on 2026-09-11 and the last three months start on 2026-07-11.
- Every payment received in such a window counts at its posted amount whether or not it was later returned.
- The payments are the consumer payments posted on the account's money history, sorted by their payment channel.

## Decision table

| Credit-card payment in the last month | Bank-debit payment in the last three months | Payments counted (all from the last month) |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Debit-card, credit-card and bank-debit payments |
| Yes | No | Debit-card and credit-card payments |
| No | Yes | Debit-card payments only |
| No | No | Debit-card payments only |

## Hypothetical worked cases

*Invented money histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

| Payments on file | Row that applies | Total counted |
|---|---|---|
| Debit card $300.00 on 2026-09-25; credit card $200.00 on 2026-10-02; bank debit $500.00 on 2026-08-01 | Credit card in the last month, bank debit in the last three months | $300.00 plus $200.00 (the 2026-08-01 bank debit is outside the last month, so it adds nothing) gives $500.00 |
| Same, but the bank debit was on 2026-09-30 | Same row | $300.00 plus $200.00 plus $500.00 gives $1000.00 |
| Debit card $300.00 on 2026-09-25; credit card $200.00 on 2026-10-02; no bank debit since May | Credit card in the last month, no bank debit in three months | $500.00 |
| Debit card $300.00 on 2026-09-25; bank debit $500.00 on 2026-09-30; no credit card | Every other case | $300.00 |
